title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks with flaky-tolerances
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Adds a new GitHub Actions / CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt-set regression suite on PRs that touch prompt sets, model adapters, or inference routing. Motivation: prevent silent prompt regressions from being merged (ENG-9876). The hook runs a fast subset of prompt evaluations with configurable per-metric thresholds and flaky tolerances; it will block merges when regressions exceed configured tolerances and will annotate the PR with a summary table and links to full eval artifacts. Implementation notes: new lightweight runner (eval-harness/ci/hooks/run_prompt_regressions.py), a workflow file (.github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml) that gates on path filters, and a YAML config for default gating thresholds (eval-harness/config/prompt_gate_defaults.yaml). This PR also adds integration tests and documentation. Checklist: - implement runner and config - integrate into GitHub Actions with path filters - add tests covering gating logic and flaky tolerance handling - add docs and playbook for triaging failing gates Related: ENG-9876, PM-210.

release_notes: Adds a CI gate that prevents prompt-set regressions from being merged. The gate is configurable via eval-harness/config/prompt_gate_defaults.yaml and supports flaky tolerances and an opt-out label. Improves detection of unseen prompt regressions and provides annotated artifacts for triage.
testing_plan: Unit tests for gating logic and flaky-tolerance behavior included in eval-harness/tests. Integration tests run the fast subset of prompt sets in CI; artifacts are uploaded for manual triage. Manual staging run performed against a known-good commit and a known-broken commit to validate blocking behavior.
notes_for_sre: Long runs are gated; workflow uses path filters to reduce cost. If the gate is noisy, add label 'ci:skip-eval-harness' and open ENG-9876 for investigation. Observability: added metric eval_harness.gate.duration and eval_harness.gate.failures to the SLO dashboard.
